==================
with identifiers and record with expressions
==================

record R(int X) {
    R M(R with) {
        var other = with with { X = with.X + 1 };
        return other;
    }
}

---

(compilation_unit
  (record_declaration
    (identifier)
    (parameter_list
      (parameter
        (predefined_type)
        (identifier)))
    (declaration_list
      (method_declaration
        (identifier)
        (identifier)
        (parameter_list
          (parameter
            (identifier)
            (identifier)))
        (block
          (local_declaration_statement
            (variable_declaration
              (implicit_type)
              (variable_declarator
                (identifier)
                (with_expression
                  (identifier)
                  (with_initializer
                    (identifier)
                    (binary_expression
                      (member_access_expression
                        (identifier)
                        (identifier))
                      (integer_literal)))))))
          (return_statement
            (identifier)))))))
